title: Passport
empty: No flown flights yet — the passport fills up with the first entry.
needsFlights: The passport is built from your flights. Switch the Flights area on in settings to see it.
loadError: The passport could not be loaded.

summary.countriesTotalExplained: The second number is every country for which there is any evidence at all. The first counts only those whose evidence reaches the threshold.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.headlineNote: {{counted}} of {{total}} countries with evidence are counted — counting starts at the tier “{{threshold}}”. The rest stay in the list, greyed out, so you can check and correct them.
evidence.kindsSumNote: this split adds up to every country with evidence, not to the counted headline

tiers.sleptExplained: The calendar day changed: a completed stay, a recorded lodging, a port call spanning a night, a pair of flights across a day boundary — or two consecutive days in your location history.
tiers.visitedExplained: Arrival and departure on the same calendar day, a recorded place, a day in port — or a day your location history records in this country and no other.
tiers.connectionExplained: A connecting flight and nothing else. Nothing records whether you left the airport, so this country does not count. Add a place, a stay or another flight and the tier goes up.
tiers.transitedExplained: Your location history places you here on a day you were also in another country — a border crossed on the ground. That is not a change of planes: you were in the country, often for hours, so it counts.

value.notApplicableEntries: Not applicable: no flight proves this country — not zero entries, but none there would be to count.
value.notApplicableAirports: Not applicable: no airport was used here.
value.unknownPeriod: Unknown: no record carries a date.
value.daysPresentExplained: Distinct calendar days on which a record places you in this country. Counted, not estimated — and the number does not decide the tier.
value.noDatedDays: Zero days counted: no record names a day. That is not a missing value but the result of the count — the “undated” note on this row says why.

ground.measuredExplained: Measured: the longest spell on the ground between a landing and the next departure in this country. Shown raw rather than sorted into classes — and it does not decide the tier.
ground.unknownExplained: Unknown: a flight touched this country, but no pair of clocks bounds a spell — an outbound leg with no return, or a booking carrying only a date. Record the missing flight and a time appears here.
ground.notApplicableExplained: Not applicable: no flight touched this country. A lodging, a day in port or a place bounds no departure — there is nothing to add here and nothing to measure.

provenance.intro: These records put the country in the passport. Each one opens the record — that is where you change it.
provenance.loadError: The records could not be loaded. That does not mean there are none.
provenance.truncated: Only the most recent records are shown.
provenance.none: No individual record available. The country belongs in the list all the same — there is simply no single record to open here.
provenance.trackNote: These days come from your location history, not from a record you created. How many points held each day up is shown; whether a point was measured by GPS or estimated from a photograph is not something the data says, so it is not said here either.

continents.title: Continents
continents.denominator: Measured against the countries this catalogue knows — not against a total number of countries in the world, for which there is no agreed figure.

countries.title: Countries
countries.listNote: This list shows every country with any evidence — including the ones that are not counted. Those are greyed out rather than removed, so you can check them.
countries.dashLegend: “—” does not mean zero, it means not derivable: a country proved only by a lodging or a port call has no flights and no airports — and without a dated record, no period either.
countries.groundTimeLegend: “Time on the ground” has three answers, and two of them are not a value: “unknown” means a flight was here but no second one bounds the stay — that you can fill in. “—” means no flight was here at all; a lodging bounds no departure, so there is nothing to add. “Days”, by contrast, is always counted: 0 means no record names a day.
countries.notCountedExplained: This country does not reach the threshold for the headline. It stays in the list all the same: the tier comes from what was recorded, and what was recorded is incomplete.
countries.undatedExplained: At least one record carries no date. This country therefore cannot appear in any year's figures.

options.visited: Stay — neither a connection nor passing through counts
options.transited: Passing through — a connection does not count

effect.visited: Only countries you actually stayed in count. Passing straight through on the ground and changing planes at an airport then both fail to count. Your country total goes down.
effect.slept: Only countries with a recorded night count — through a lodging, a port call spanning a night, or a pair of flights across a day boundary. Your country total goes down.
effect.connection: Merely changing planes at an airport then counts as a country. Your country total goes up.
effect.transited: Merely changing planes at an airport does not count. A border you crossed on the ground, a day in port, a recorded place and every overnight stay still do. This is the default.

thresholdChoice.listUnchanged: This does not change the country list in your passport: every country with evidence stays visible, uncounted ones are merely greyed out. Only the headline number moves.
